snippet.title: 엄마의 말한마디에 시작된 거미춤ㄷㄷ
snippet.description:
이 춤의 첫 관객은 심사위원이 아니라 거실에서 웃음이 터진 엄마였어요.

우크라이나 출신 발레리나 밀레나 시도로바는 어릴 때부터 거미를 좋아해서 거미가 움직이는 모습을 자주 지켜봤다고 해요. 발레를 배우던 13살 무렵, 거실에서 거미 흉내를 내자 엄마가 크게 웃으며 "그걸 춤으로 만들어 봐"라고 했고, 두 달 뒤 처음 무대에 올린 작품이 바로 '더 스파이더(The Spider)'예요. 이후 모스크바, 키이우, 스페인, 스위스 로잔, 런던의 국제 발레 대회에서 이 춤을 췄어요.
보기엔 장난 같지만 어려운 건 기술보다 유연성이라, 고관절과 허리가 이만큼 열리는 사람은 프로 무용수 중에도 드물다고 해요. 자세가 조금만 어긋나도 거미가 아니라 개구리처럼 보인대요.
그녀는 이후 네덜란드 국립발레단에서 17년 동안 무용수로 활동했고, 지금은 같은 발레단의 안무가로 일하고 있어요. 그리고 이 춤을 본 영화 '듄'(2021) 제작진이 직접 연락해 와서, 하코넨 남작이 기르는 사람 손 달린 거미 괴물 역을 맡게 됐어요(모션 캡처 연기, 크레딧 이름 'Human Spider Proxy').

snippet.title: The huge girder launcher place 700 ton box girder precisely
snippet.description:
This 10 second delayed image condensed records the complete operation process of setting up box girders on the Hewu high-speed railway bridge erecting machine. This bridge erecting machine, with a rated lifting capacity of 900 tons, is responsible for hoisting a single prefabricated simply supported box girder weighing 700 tons and a length of 32.6 meters. The beam erecting operation is carried out at the open bridge site on the river bank. The entire process includes moving the bridge erecting machine forward, lifting the girder, longitudinal moving, aligning and lowering the girder, and leveling and locking the support. The entire process relies on multiple sets of hydraulic support legs and synchronous measurement and control systems to coordinate and control the stable placement of the giant box girder on the concrete bridge pier. The box girder erection is the core node of the construction of the high-speed railway line under the transfer line. A large number of prefabricated box girders are transported to the site for erection after standardized production in the beam yard, greatly improving the construction efficiency.

Cehennem Kanyonu’nda patlayan silahla Adil, Esme’nin kollarına yığılır. Şerif, Fadime’yi kaçırır. Adil’in Esme’den son isteği kardeşini kurtarması, son sözü ise “Efulim… Mahşerde…” olur.

Hastaneye gidilmesi Fadime’nin ölümü demektir. Eleni, babasını yaşatmak için hiç bilmediği çok zor bir ameliyatı yapmak zorunda kalır. Oruç, kırık kolundaki askıyı çıkarıp Eleni’ye yardım eder, Cengiz ameliyathaneyi kurar. Adil’in hayatı artık, babasının kızı olmayı bırakıp doktor olmayı başaran Eleni’nin ellerindedir. Adil’i ölümün ellerine bırakan kurşunu sıkan İso, ömrünün en ağır vicdan azabında boğulurken Fadime’nin peşine düşer. Fadime ile İso’nun sevdası, Şerif’in zalimliği karşısında en acı sınavını verir. Yüreği paramparça olsa da kızıyla el ele verip dimdik ayakta duran Esme, Adil’in yokluğunda Koçari’nin reisi olarak Şerif’in karşısına dikilir. Ama Şerif’in şartları çok zalimdir. snippet.title: Let’s make Thanksgiving in my in Parisian kitchen #paris #thanksgiving #cooking #kitchen #apartment
snippet.description:
My full Thanksgiving cooking tutorial will be on my YouTube this Sunday! I’ll show you how I prepared and organized this entire menu over two days 

Which recipe would you like the most?

I’ve also linked my outfit, oven, kitchen tools, vintage bowls and plates, and more in the linktree in my bio or below!

Outfit and tools- https://shopmy.us/shop/collections/9504436
Tools- https://amzn.to/4kya0k2
Vintage bowls - https://shopmy.us/shop/ainsleydurose?Section_id=1902791&tab=collections
Oven- https://go.shopmy.us/p-111359547

This year I wanted to do something a little different, so I made a turkey ballotine with a chestnut, sage, and pistachio stuffing with a cognac jus, and it was…..sublime😍 and I think it would be such a beautiful dish to make for Christmas, too. Let me know if you’d like a full tutorial!

What are you thankful for this year? 

I’m so thankful for my husband, who encourages me, supports me, and helped me film these last 2 days. 

For my friends, who are always happy to squeeze around a table in a tiny space. 

For the champagne from @champagne_bourgeoisdiaz 

For the beautiful turkey and all the lovely cheeses from @boucheriepetiteperigourdine
 
For the beautiful produce from Place Monge and Place Maubert markets

For my small but mighty oven that actually didn’t break until the very end!😅(My Black Friday is now being spent trying to find a replacement, yay!)

For my hand cream for saving my hands after approximately 947 rounds of washing dishes.

And perhaps most importantly, thankful that I only broke ONE wine glass the entire time, and the only thing I managed to spill on my apron was red wine….right at the end😂but thankfully, not on my sweater. We take the little victories.

Thankful for all of you, too, for being here and letting me share these little moments from my life in Paris🤎

I hope everyone had a lovely Thanksgiving day🥰

The Thanksgiving menu:
• Cranberry jelly• Aligot• Honey glazed carrots• Haricots verts au beurre noisette, échalotes et noisettes• Raclette mac and cheese• Braided leeks with a creme fraiche and shallot cream• Cornbread stuffing with sausage, sage, apple, and chestnuts• Pull-apart bread with Camembert• Kabocha, pear and pecan frangipane tart • Ballotine de dinde aux marrons, champignons et pistaches, with a Cognac, Madeira and roasted poultry jus
 
A little note: the dishes in this reel aren’t shown in the order I made them. I wanted to show each recipe from beginning to end rather than jump between dishes and make everything confusing. The kitchen was chaotic enough as it was! But again, the full process will be on my Youtube this Sunday, so make sure to subscribe to be  notified when I upload!

snippet.title: Why Microsoft Declared Code Red | Shop Talk EP106
snippet.description:
Microsoft declared an internal Code Red after a Microsoft 365 outage that lasted about a day. Dave and Glen ask what it would take to keep the next failure from spreading and get customers back online within Microsoft’s one-hour recovery target.

They also discuss the separate 1Password security incident and why the distinction between customer account information and the contents of an encrypted vault matters. Then a viewer asks whether adding more backup layers makes big services more resilient or gives them more ways to fail. Back in the Garage, Dave revisits the mystery of two PDP-11s dropping packets.

snippet.title: i'm being oathentic, i promise
snippet.description:
t’s an oatcession for sure 🤭

Just a girl with a spoon and a dream to show everyone how amazing oats are, and I think I’m doing ok 🙈

✨recipe✨
50g oat flour* (or oats blended to flour OR regular oats
30g of vegan vanilla protein powder*(important for thick texture!)
100g of Greek yoghurt or skyr 
5g milled flax seeds
3g of psyllium husk (optional, but helps thicken the oats and adds more fibre)
1 tsp cinnamon
90 ml of water or milk (I just used water)
Pinch of salt
splash of vanilla extract

For the cream layer:
50-60g of yoghurt mixed with maple syrup

For the biscoff top:
20g of biscoff spread
5g coconut oil


Mix the oat ingredients and place them in a ramekin/bowl. Refrigerate to let thicken for 1-2 hours.

Make the yoghurt layer, then spread over the oats. Melt the Biscoff and coconut oil together in the microwave and drizzle over the top to form a shell. Refrigerate overnight and enjoy!

#proteinoats #overnightoats #healthybreakfast
#oats #proteinbreakfast
